summary: The Drop file service and every link shortener are gone: route and place_info now give the full Google Maps link, and files she shares by link open in the web app behind sign-in.
details: The drop and valkey services, the old short-link Worker, the [shortener] config section and NORA_DROP_TOKEN are removed.
A map link in a reply is the full Google Maps address, so it is longer in the chat but shows where it goes.
limitations: Every old Drop link (nora.67.zone/drop/...) and short link (/i/...) already sent stops resolving; nothing redirects them.
A config.toml that still has a [shortener] section keeps loading (the key is read by nothing); delete it when convenient.
Drop's artifacts table and its drop-artifacts bucket are left in place, unread.
